violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by a hose nozzle and a roll of trash bags in the sink basin. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Equipment was removed from the sink basin during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Raw marinated chicken was observed held above raw marinated beef. The items were rearranged during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The chlorine concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 25 parts per million (ppm). The concentration of chlorine in the sanitizing solution must be between 50-100 ppm. The chlorine concentration was adjusted and tested at 50 parts per million (ppm) during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Raw animal foods (such as shrimp and shell eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as prepared pork and vegetables) in the 2-door reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Raw animal foods were moved during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025

Birria sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Per PIC, food item was prepared the previous day at 8pm and was observed at temperatures ranging from 48-53 degrees Fahrenheit. Food items were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, birria sauce was placed hot in the refrigerator in plastic containers greater than four inches deep. Proper cooling methods were reviewed and guidance was provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025

The door to the storage room, located in the rear, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2024

A proper air gap is lacking at the ice machine. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2024
The doors to the toilet rooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2024
